title: Applicability.
officialText: Alterations, additions, repairs and changes of occupancy of fireproof multiple dwellings erected prior to December 6, 1968, and classified as HAEA (1929-1968) and HAEB (1929-1968) shall comply with the provisions of this code and the additional provisions of Chapter D3.
